'''Ryan Oneil''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[July 2001 Tustin tournament]] on 8 July 2001 with [[Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi / Their Fire Has Gone Out Of The Universe|Hunt Down (IAO, Mob Pts, No Escape)]], according to Michael Mendoza's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2610">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-07-09-longshot-in-tustin-ca-7-8-01d2610/ longshot-in-tustin-ca-7-8-01], DeckTech (Michael "Longshot" Mendoza, 9 July 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-07-09-longshot-in-tustin-ca-7-8-01d2610/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
